info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Banking Enterprise Services Security Assurance By Security Assurance Id-v5-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the retrieval of security assurance details for banking enterprise services using a specific Security Assurance ID. It provides essential information related to the security measures implemented within banking services, allowing users to verify compliance and security standards. Typical consumers include security auditors, compliance officers, and financial institution administrators who require access to security assurance data for analysis and reporting purposes. This operation is crucial for ensuring robust security governance in banking environments.

get.description: Fetches the details of the Security Assurance Resource identified by RES-100045. This endpoint is used to obtain information related to security measures and compliance status for the specified resource.
